changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Editar mascotas' AS name, 'animal.update' AS code, 'OWNERS_ANIMALS' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear guarderias', 'daycare.create', 'DAYCARE' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver guarderias', 'daycare.read', 'DAYCARE' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar guarderias', 'daycare.update', 'DAYCARE' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar guarderias', 'daycare.delete', 'DAYCARE' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ('animal.update', 'daycare.create', 'daycare.read', 'daycare.update', 'daycare.delete') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ('animal.update', 'daycare.create', 'daycare.read', 'daycare.update', 'daycare.delete'));
